ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p110/r5.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p110/r5.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p110/r5.claim: The sūrah distinguishes the characteristics of Paradise for the muqarrabīn from those for the asḥāb al-yamīn.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p110/r5.anchor: the muqarrabīn shall receive are delineated, followed by the features and characteristics of the Paradise which the asḥāb al-yamīn will be blessed with

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p130/r4.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p130/r4.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p130/r4.claim: Min dunihima may mean besides, in contrast with, or lesser than the first two gardens; the refrain signals that further gardens and favours remain.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p130/r4.anchor: can be translated as “besides these two” and “in contrast with these two” as well as “lesser than these two.”

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p69/r9.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p69/r9.speaker: ابن زيد والأكثرون
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p69/r9.claim: Ibn Zayd and most exegetes say the two gardens mentioned later are lower in rank and belong to the people of the right, while the first pair belongs to the foremost.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p69/r9.anchor: لأصحاب اليمين، والأوليان هما للسابقين، قاله ابن زيد والأكثرون

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p69/r10.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p69/r10.speaker: الحسن
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p69/r10.claim: Al-Ḥasan says the first pair is for the foremost and the second pair for the followers.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p69/r10.anchor: وقال الحسن: الأوليان للسابقين، والأخريان للتابعين

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p69/r11.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p69/r11.speaker: ابن عباس
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p69/r11.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās says the later gardens are closer to their beneficiaries but superior to the first pair; al-Zamakhsharī favors this reading.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p69/r11.anchor: وقال ابن عباس: ومن دونهما في القرب للمنعمين، والمؤخرتا الذكر أفضل من الأوليين

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p69/r12.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p69/r12.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p69/r12.claim: Supporters of the first ranking cite the first pair's flowing springs, greater abundance of fruit, brocade-lined couches rather than canopies, finer silk, and ruby-and-coral description.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p69/r12.anchor: ورجح غيره القول الأول بذكر جري العينين والنضخ دون الجري

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:55:46/r17.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:55:46/r17.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:55:46/r17.claim: In light of the meanings of dun and related reports, the verse can mean either two gardens at a lower rank than the first two or two more gardens beyond them.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:55:46/r17.anchor: bu âyete, “Bu ikisinden daha aşağı mertebede iki cennet daha vardır” ve “Bu ikisinin ötesinde iki cennet daha vardır” mânaları da verilmiştir

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:55:46/r18.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:55:46/r18.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:55:46/r18.claim: Ibn Atiyya characterizes these deductions about rank as uncertain inferences.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:55:46/r18.anchor: Şu var ki İbn Atıyye’nin belirttiği üzere bunlar kesinlik taşımayan çıkarımlardır

TABATABAI:55:31-78/r7.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:55:31-78/r7.speaker: أبو عبد الله عليه السلام
TABATABAI:55:31-78/r7.claim: Al-Ala b. Sayaba reports that Abu Abdallah answers people asking whether those who leave Hell will join God’s friends in Paradise: they will not, as indicated by the two gardens beneath the first pair.
TABATABAI:55:31-78/r7.anchor: عن العلاء بن سيابة عن أبي عبد الله عليه السلام قلت له إن الناس يتعجبون منا إذا قلنا يخرج قوم من النار

TABATABAI:55:31-78/r8.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:55:31-78/r8.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
TABATABAI:55:31-78/r8.claim: A report through Abu Musa assigns two gardens of gold to those brought near and two gardens of silver to the companions of the right.
TABATABAI:55:31-78/r8.anchor: عن أبي موسى عن النبي صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم في قوله { ولمن خاف مقام ربه جنتان } وقوله { ومن دونهما جنتان } قال جنتان من ذهب

TABRISI:55:62-78/r14.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:55:62-78/r14.speaker: author
TABRISI:55:62-78/r14.claim: Dahmah means blackness; a field becomes dark when fully watered, and the word also names a calamity because of its darkness.
TABRISI:55:62-78/r14.anchor: الدهمة السواد وإدهام الزرع إذا علاه السواد ريا ومنه الدهماء وتصغيره الدهيماء للداهية

NAHHAS:v4p315/r6.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v4p315/r6.speaker: ابن عباس
NAHHAS:v4p315/r6.claim: Ibn Abbas takes the two gardens to be lower in rank and identifies them with the hidden comfort of 32:17.
NAHHAS:v4p315/r6.anchor: قولان أحدهما ومن دونهما في الدرج وهذا مذهب ابن عباس

NAHHAS:v4p315/r7.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v4p315/r7.speaker: ابن زيد
NAHHAS:v4p315/r7.claim: Ibn Zayd takes them to be lower in merit and belonging to the people of the right.
NAHHAS:v4p315/r7.anchor: والقول الآخر ومن دونهما في الفضل وهذا مذهب ابن زيد قال وهم لأصحاب اليمين

SAMIN-DURR:55:62/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:55:62/r1.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:55:62/r1.claim: The two gardens are beneath the two previously described gardens in rank and beauty, on the apparent interpretation.
SAMIN-DURR:55:62/r1.anchor: أي: من دون تينك الجنتين المتقدمتين: جنتان في المنزلة وحسن المنظر

SAMIN-DURR:55:62/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:55:62/r2.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:55:62/r2.claim: The apparent reading of the comparison makes the first pair of gardens superior to the second pair.
SAMIN-DURR:55:62/r2.anchor: وهذا على الظاهر من أن الأوليين أفضل من الأخريين

SAMIN-DURR:55:62/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:55:62/r3.speaker: الزمخشري
SAMIN-DURR:55:62/r3.claim: An alternative reverses the ranking, making the latter pair superior; al-Zamakhshari prefers this view.

ZAJJAJ:v5p103/r2.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v5p103/r2.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v5p103/r2.claim: The person who fears the station of the Lord has two gardens in addition to the first two.
ZAJJAJ:v5p103/r2.anchor: أي لمن خاف مقام ربه جنتان وله من دونهما جنتان.

ZAJJAJ:v5p103/r3.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v5p103/r3.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v5p103/r3.claim: In Arabic, jannah means a garden or orchard.
ZAJJAJ:v5p103/r3.anchor: أي لمن خاف مقام ربه جنتان وله من دونهما جنتان. والجنة في لغة العرب البستان.

ASAD-NOTES:55:62/r1.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:55:62/r1.speaker: author
ASAD-NOTES:55:62/r1.claim: Besides the two gardens already described, there are two further gardens.
ASAD-NOTES:55:62/r1.anchor: besides those two will be yet two [other] gardens

ALUSI-FULL:v27p121/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p121/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v27p121/r1.claim: The construction introduces two further gardens situated below the first pair in rank and standing.

ALUSI-FULL:v27p121/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p121/r2.speaker: ابن زيد والأكثرون
ALUSI-FULL:v27p121/r2.claim: Ibn Zayd and most authorities assign the first pair to the foremost and the later two to the people of the right.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p121/r2.anchor: قال ابن زيد والأكثرون الأو للسابقين

ALUSI-FULL:v27p121/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p121/r3.speaker: أبو موسى
ALUSI-FULL:v27p121/r3.claim: Abu Musa transmits from the Prophet that the two gardens for those fearing their Lord are gold for the brought-near and silver for the people of the right.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p121/r3.anchor: عن أبي موسى عن النبي صلى الله تعالى عليه وسلم

ALUSI-FULL:v27p121/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p121/r4.speaker: الحسن
ALUSI-FULL:v27p121/r4.claim: Al-Hasan says the first gardens are for the foremost and the later pair for their followers.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p121/r4.anchor: وقال الحسن : الأوليان للسابقين والأخريان للتابعين

ALUSI-FULL:v27p121/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p121/r5.speaker: أبو موسى
ALUSI-FULL:v27p121/r5.claim: A version of Abu Musa’s report is transmitted as a Companion statement and authenticated by al-Hakim.

ALUSI-FULL:v27p121/r6.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p121/r6.speaker: بعضهم
ALUSI-FULL:v27p121/r6.claim: Some say the later gardens are for descendants joined to those who fear God; al-Alusi says he found no supporting transmitted evidence.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p121/r6.anchor: وزعم بعضهم أن الأولين للخائفين والآخرين لذرياتهم

ALUSI-FULL:v27p121/r7.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p121/r7.speaker: ابن عباس
ALUSI-FULL:v27p121/r7.claim: Al-Baḥr cites Ibn Abbas taking ‘below them’ as nearness for the blessed and the later-mentioned gardens as superior because their descriptions are more laudatory.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p121/r7.anchor: وحكى في البحر عن ابن عباس أنه قال : ( ومن دونها )

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p456/r1.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p456/r1.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p456/r1.claim: These are two further gardens besides the first pair.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p456/r1.anchor: ومن دونهما جنتان} ، أي من دون الجنتين الأوليين جنتان أخريان.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p456/r2.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p456/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p456/r2.claim: Ibn Abbas places them lower in rank.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p456/r2.anchor: قال ابن عباس: من دونهما في الدرج.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p456/r3.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p456/r3.speaker: ابن زيد
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p456/r3.claim: Ibn Zayd says they are lower in merit.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p456/r3.anchor: وقال ابن زيد: من دونهما في الفضل.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p456/r4.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p456/r4.speaker: أبو موسى الأشعري
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p456/r4.claim: Abu Musa says the two gardens of gold are for the foremost and the two of silver for those who follow.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p456/r4.anchor: وقال أبو موسى الأشعري: جنتان من ذهب للسابقين وجنتان من فضة للتابعين.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p456/r5.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p456/r5.speaker: ابن جريج
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p456/r5.claim: Ibn Jurayj says four gardens are meant: two for the foremost brought near and two for the people of the right, with fruit described again at 55:68.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p456/r5.anchor: وقال ابن جريج: هن أربع جنتان للمقربين السابقين فيهما من كل من فاكهة زوجان،

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p456/r6.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p456/r6.speaker: رسول الله
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p456/r6.claim: The Prophet describes two gardens of silver and two of gold, their vessels and contents matching those metals; only the veil of majesty separates the people from seeing their Lord in the Garden of Eden.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p456/r6.anchor: عن أبيه عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: "جنتان من فضة آنيتهما وما فيهما، وجنتان من ذهب آنيتهما وما فيهما،

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p456/r7.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p456/r7.speaker: الكسائي
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p456/r7.claim: Al-Kisāʾī takes “min dūnihimā” as “in front of them,” supported by al-Dahhak’s view that the first gardens are gold and silver and the latter two ruby.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p456/r7.anchor: وقال الكسائي: "ومن دونهما جنتان" أي أمامهما وقبلهما، يدل عليه قول الضحاك: الجنتان الأوليان من ذهب وفضة والأخريان من ياقوت.

BAYDAWI-FULL:55:55-62/r7.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:55:55-62/r7.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:55:55-62/r7.claim: The two gardens below the first pair are for people of lower rank among the companions of the right hand.

BIQAI-FULL:v7p395/r9.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v7p395/r9.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v7p395/r9.claim: These two gardens lie below the first pair in place and rank and are for the lower-ranking, God-fearing people of the right hand, beneath the gardens of the foremost doers of good.
BIQAI-FULL:v7p395/r9.anchor: أي من أدنى مكان , رتبة مما تحت جنتي هؤلاء المحسنين المقربين

BIQAI-FULL:v7p395/r10.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v7p395/r10.speaker: ابن عباس
BIQAI-FULL:v7p395/r10.claim: Ibn Abbas understands ‘below them’ to mean lower in degree.
BIQAI-FULL:v7p395/r10.anchor: قال ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما : دونهما في الدرج

BIQAI-FULL:v7p395/r11.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v7p395/r11.speaker: ابن برجان
BIQAI-FULL:v7p395/r11.claim: Ibn Barrajān distributes the four gardens between the two groups and sees their number as alluding to the four seasons; he interprets the gold and silver gardens report accordingly.
BIQAI-FULL:v7p395/r11.anchor: وجعل ابن برجان الأربع موزعة بين الكل , وأن تخصيص هذه العدة

BIQAI-FULL:v7p395/r12.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v7p395/r12.speaker: ابن برجان
BIQAI-FULL:v7p395/r12.claim: Ibn Barrajān also allows ‘below’ to mean nearer to human beings, identifying these gardens with the intermediate realm and its inhabitants.
BIQAI-FULL:v7p395/r12.anchor: ثم جوز أن يكون المراد بالدون الأدنى إلى الإنسان , وهو البرزخ

DURR-FULL:v7p715/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v7p715/r1.speaker: الحسن
DURR-FULL:v7p715/r1.claim: Al-Ḥasan says these are two gardens below the first pair, with flowing springs.
DURR-FULL:v7p715/r1.anchor: عن الحسن في قوله {ومن دونهما جنتان} قال: هما دون تجريان

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p264/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p264/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p264/r4.claim: One possibility is that the dual denotes two categories of gardens; the later mention of two gardens beneath these supports this reading.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p264/r4.anchor: فيجيء النظر في تأويل تثنية { جنتان } فيجوز أن يكون المراد : جنسين من الجنات

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p234#2/r7.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p234#2/r7.speaker: ابن زيد
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p234#2/r7.claim: Ibn Zayd and others take the two gardens as lower in rank and capacity: the first pair belongs to the forerunners and the second to the people of the right.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p234#2/r7.anchor: فقال ابن زيد وغيره معناه: أن هذين دون تينك في المنزلة والقدرة

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p234#2/r8.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p234#2/r8.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p234#2/r8.claim: Al-Rummānī quotes Ibn ʿAbbās as saying all four gardens belong to whoever fears standing before their Lord.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p234#2/r8.anchor: قال الرماني قال ابن عباس: الجنات الأربع للخائف مقام ربه

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p234#2/r9.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p234#2/r9.speaker: الحسن
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p234#2/r9.claim: Al-Ḥasan assigns the first two gardens to the forerunners and the latter two to their followers.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p234#2/r9.anchor: وقال الحسن الأوليان للسابقين والأخريان للتابعين

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p234#2/r10.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p234#2/r10.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p234#2/r10.claim: A second interpretation from Ibn ʿAbbās says the later-mentioned pair is better than the first pair, since its fountains gush and its gardens are intensely green, unlike the earlier pair's flowing fountains and branches.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p234#2/r10.anchor: وقال ابن عباس، المعنى: هما دونهما

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p235/r1.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p235/r1.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p235/r1.claim: Most people follow the first interpretation of the gardens, though Ibn Atiyya says its supporting arguments are not decisive.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p235/r1.anchor: قال القاضي أبو محمد: وأكثر الناس على التأويل الأول، وهذه استدلالات ليست بقواطع

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p235/r2.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p235/r2.speaker: أبو موسى الأشعري
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p235/r2.claim: Abu Musa says the two gardens for those brought near are gold, while the two lower gardens for the people of the right are silver.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p235/r2.anchor: وروي عن أبي موسى الأشعري أنه قال: جنتان للمقربين من ذهب، وجنتان لأهل اليمين من فضة

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p124/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p124/r1.speaker: الزجاج
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p124/r1.claim: Al-Zajjaj reads the phrase as adding two gardens beneath the two promised to whoever fears his Lord.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p124/r1.anchor: قال الزجاج المعنى ولمن خاف مقام ربه جنتان وله من دونهما جنتان

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p124/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p124/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p124/r2.claim: Ibn Abbas says the two gardens are lower in rank than the first pair.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p124/r2.anchor: أحدهما دونهما في الدرج قاله ابن عباس

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p124/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p124/r3.speaker: أبو موسى
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p124/r3.claim: Abu Musa reports the Prophet’s description of two gardens of gold and two of silver; Ibn Zayd and Muqatil take the latter pair as lower in merit.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p124/r3.anchor: كما روى أبو موسى عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أنه قال جنتان من ذهب وجنتان من فضة

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p124/r4.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p124/r4.speaker: ابن زيد ومقاتل
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p124/r4.claim: Ibn Zayd and Muqatil interpret the two gardens as lower in merit.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p124/r4.anchor: وإلى نحو هذا ذهب ابن زيد ومقاتل

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p506/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p506/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p506/r1.claim: The two gardens are below the preceding pair in rank, virtue, and status, as the Qur'anic wording itself indicates.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p506/r1.anchor: هاتان الجنتان دون اللتين قبلهما في المرتبة والفضيلة والمنزلة بنص القرآن

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p506/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p506/r2.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p506/r2.claim: A previously cited hadith describes two gardens with gold vessels and contents for those brought near, and two with silver vessels and contents for the people of the right.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p506/r2.anchor: جنتان من ذهب آنيتهما وما فيهما، وجنتان من فضة آنيتهما وما فيهما

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p506/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p506/r3.speaker: أبو موسى
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p506/r3.claim: Abu Musa assigns the two golden gardens to those brought near and the two silver gardens to the people of the right.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p506/r3.anchor: وقال أبو موسى: جنتان من ذهب للمقربين، وجنتان من فضة لأصحاب اليمين

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p506/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p506/r4.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p506/r4.claim: Ibn Abbas interprets below as lower in degrees.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p506/r4.anchor: وقال ابن عباس: {ومن دونهما جنتان} من دونهما في الدرج

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p506/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p506/r5.speaker: ابن زيد
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p506/r5.claim: Ibn Zayd interprets below as lower in merit.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p506/r5.anchor: وقال ابن زيد: من دونهما في الفضل

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p506/r6.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p506/r6.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p506/r6.claim: The first pair's preceding mention signals special concern and superiority; the following phrase that these gardens are below them confirms the earlier pair's higher rank.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p506/r6.anchor: أنه نعت الأولين قبل هاتين، والتقديم يدل على الاعتناء ثم قال: {ومن دونهما جنتان}

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p506/r13.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p506/r13.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p506/r13.claim: The first pair has two flowing springs, while the second has two gushing springs; flowing is stronger than gushing.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p506/r13.anchor: أي فياضتان. والجري أقوى من النضخ

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p451#2/r1.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p451#2/r1.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p451#2/r1.claim: These two gardens lie below the pair promised to those brought near, and are for the companions of the right, who rank below them.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p451#2/r1.anchor: ومن دون تينك الجنتين الموعودتين للمقربين { جنتان } لمن دونهم من أصحاب اليمين

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p440/r1.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p440/r1.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p440/r1.claim: Min dunihima can mean two gardens nearer to the first pair, or two gardens lower in rank.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p440/r1.anchor: أحدهما : أي أقرب منهما جنتان . الثاني : أي دون صفتهما جنتان

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p440/r2.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p440/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p440/r2.claim: Ibn Abbas says all four gardens belong to those who fear their Lord: the first pair has palms and trees, the latter pair crops and spreading plants.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p440/r2.anchor: أن الجنات الأربع لمن خاف مقام ربه , قال ابن عباس : فيكون في الأوليين النخل والشجر

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p440/r3.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p440/r3.speaker: ابن زيد
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p440/r3.claim: Ibn Zayd assigns the first pair, made of gold, to those brought near and the latter pair, made of silver, to the people of the right.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p440/r3.anchor: أن الأوليين من ذهب للمقربين , والأخريين من ورق لأصحاب اليمين , قاله ابن زيد

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p440/r4.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p440/r4.speaker: الحسن
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p440/r4.claim: Hasan assigns the first pair to the foremost and the latter pair to their followers.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p440/r4.anchor: أن الأوليين للسابقين , والأخريين للتابعين , قاله الحسن

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p440/r5.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p440/r5.speaker: مقاتل
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p440/r5.claim: Maqatil identifies the first pair as the Garden of Eden and the Garden of Bliss, and the latter pair as al-Firdaws and the Garden of Refuge; each pair includes many gardens.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p440/r5.anchor: قال مقاتل : الجنتان الأوليان جنة عدن وجنة النعيم والأخريان جنة الفردوس وجنة المأوى

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p440/r6.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p440/r6.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p440/r6.claim: Al-Mawardi also suggests the lower gardens may belong to the first pair's followers because of their lesser station, with one for houris and one for immortal youths.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p440/r6.anchor: أن يكون من دونهما جنتان لأتباعه , لقصور منزلتهم عن منزلته

MUQATIL:55:56-69/r8.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:55:56-69/r8.speaker: author
MUQATIL:55:56-69/r8.claim: Below the gardens of those brought near, the truthful, and the martyrs in rank are two gardens: Firdaws and Ma'wa.
MUQATIL:55:56-69/r8.anchor: يعني ومن دون جنتى المقربين والصديقين، والشهداء في الفضل { جنتان } [آية: 62] وهما جنة الفردوس، وجنة المأوى

NASAFI-FULL:v4p205#5/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p205#5/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p205#5/r1.claim: These are two gardens below the two gardens promised to those brought near, for those of the right.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p205#5/r1.anchor: ومن دون تبينك الجنتين الموعودتين للمقربين

QURTUBI-FULL:55:62-64/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:55:62-64/r1.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:55:62-64/r1.claim: The verse introduces two further gardens in addition to the first pair.
QURTUBI-FULL:55:62-64/r1.anchor: أي وله من دون الجنتين الأوليين جنتان أخريان.

QURTUBI-FULL:55:62-64/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:55:62-64/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
QURTUBI-FULL:55:62-64/r2.claim: Ibn Abbas takes below them as lower in rank.
QURTUBI-FULL:55:62-64/r2.anchor: قال ابن عباس: ومن دونهما في الدرج.

QURTUBI-FULL:55:62-64/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:55:62-64/r3.speaker: ابن زيد
QURTUBI-FULL:55:62-64/r3.claim: Ibn Zayd takes below them as lower in merit.
QURTUBI-FULL:55:62-64/r3.anchor: ابن زيد: ومن دونهما في الفضل.

QURTUBI-FULL:55:62-64/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:55:62-64/r4.speaker: ابن عباس
QURTUBI-FULL:55:62-64/r4.claim: Ibn Abbas assigns palms and trees to the first pair, and crops, plants, and spreading vegetation to the second.
QURTUBI-FULL:55:62-64/r4.anchor: والجنات لمن خاف مقام ربه فيكون في الأوليين النخل والشجر

QURTUBI-FULL:55:62-64/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:55:62-64/r5.speaker: الماوردي
QURTUBI-FULL:55:62-64/r5.claim: Al-Mawardi suggests the lower gardens may be for followers of lesser rank, one for houris and another for immortal youths.
QURTUBI-FULL:55:62-64/r5.anchor: لأتباعه لقصور منزلتهم عن منزلته، إحداهما للحور العين

QURTUBI-FULL:55:62-64/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:55:62-64/r6.speaker: ابن جريج
QURTUBI-FULL:55:62-64/r6.claim: Ibn Jurayj assigns the first pair to the foremost and near ones, with paired fruits and flowing springs, and the second pair to the people of the right.
QURTUBI-FULL:55:62-64/r6.anchor: وقال ابن جريج: هي أربع: جنتان منها للسابقين المقربين

QURTUBI-FULL:55:62-64/r7.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:55:62-64/r7.speaker: ابن زيد
QURTUBI-FULL:55:62-64/r7.claim: Ibn Zayd says the first gardens are gold for those brought near and the second are silver for the people of the right.
QURTUBI-FULL:55:62-64/r7.anchor: وقال ابن زيد: إن الأوليين من ذهب للمقربين، والأخريين من ورق لأصحاب اليمين.

QURTUBI-FULL:55:62-64/r8.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:55:62-64/r8.speaker: سعيد بن جبير عن ابن عباس وأبو موسى الأشعري
QURTUBI-FULL:55:62-64/r8.claim: Saʿid ibn Jubayr transmits Ibn Abbas’s identification of the first pair as for the near ones and the second pair as for the people of the right; Abu Musa reports likewise.
QURTUBI-FULL:55:62-64/r8.anchor: رواه سعيد بن جبير عن ابن عباس

QURTUBI-FULL:55:62-64/r9.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:55:62-64/r9.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:55:62-64/r9.claim: The author endorses this ranking: all four gardens are for those who fear God, but the first pair belongs to those foremost in fear and the second to those of lesser state.
QURTUBI-FULL:55:62-64/r9.anchor: الجنان الأربع لمن خاف مقام ربه إلا أن الخائفين لهم مراتب

QURTUBI-FULL:55:62-64/r15.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:55:62-64/r15.speaker: الضحاك
QURTUBI-FULL:55:62-64/r15.claim: Al-Dahhak reverses the material ranking: the first gardens are gold and silver, while the second are ruby and emerald, which he says are finer.
QURTUBI-FULL:55:62-64/r15.anchor: الأخريين من ياقوت وزمرد وهما أفضل من الأوليين

QURTUBI-FULL:55:62-64/r16.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:55:62-64/r16.speaker: أبو عبد الله الترمذي الحكيم
QURTUBI-FULL:55:62-64/r16.claim: Al-Tirmidhi al-Hakim reads dunāhumā as in front of them and nearer to the Throne, thus taking the later pair as nearer.
QURTUBI-FULL:55:62-64/r16.anchor: ذهب أبو عبد الله الترمذي الحكيم في نوادر الأصول فقال:

QURTUBI-FULL:55:64/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:55:64/r1.speaker: مقاتل
QURTUBI-FULL:55:64/r1.claim: Muqatil identifies the first gardens as Eden and Bliss, and the later pair as Firdaws and the Garden of Refuge.
QURTUBI-FULL:55:64/r1.anchor: وقال مقاتل: الجنتان الأوليان جنة عدن وجنة النعيم

QASHANI:55:60-66/r2.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:55:60-66/r2.speaker: author
QASHANI:55:60-66/r2.claim: “Behind them” can mean in a nearby place beyond them; it does not mean in front of them relative to their occupants.
QASHANI:55:60-66/r2.anchor: من ورائهما من مكان قريب منهما كما تقول:

QASHANI:55:60-66/r3.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:55:60-66/r3.speaker: author
QASHANI:55:60-66/r3.claim: The phrase can alternatively mean “other than them,” as in the cited wording about what people worship besides God.
QASHANI:55:60-66/r3.anchor: بل بمعنى بعدهما أو من غيرهما

QASHANI:55:60-66/r4.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:55:60-66/r4.speaker: author
QASHANI:55:60-66/r4.claim: These gardens belong to the foremost and brought-near: the garden of spirit and the garden of the essence in the unity of witnessing the essence, beyond witnessing in the station of spirit.
QASHANI:55:60-66/r4.anchor: جنة الروح وجنة الذات في عين الجمع عند الشهود الذاتي

RAZI-FULL:v29p116#2/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v29p116#2/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v29p116#2/r1.claim: After mentioning the reward, God mentions its like: two further gardens, as in the promise of the best reward and an increase.
RAZI-FULL:v29p116#2/r1.anchor: لما ذكر الجزاء ذكر بعده مثله وهو جنتان أخريان

RAZI-FULL:v29p116#2/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v29p116#2/r2.speaker: صاحب الكشاف
RAZI-FULL:v29p116#2/r2.claim: Al-Zamakhshari takes below them as lower in rank, citing contrasts between these gardens and the first pair in foliage, fountains, fruit, and furnishings.
RAZI-FULL:v29p116#2/r2.anchor: وهو ما اختاره صاحب الكشاف وقال قوله : { مدهامتان } مع قوله

RAZI-FULL:v29p116#2/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v29p116#2/r3.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v29p116#2/r3.claim: He calls the rank argument weak: God's successive gifts lead recipients to expect each new gift to equal or exceed the previous one.
RAZI-FULL:v29p116#2/r3.anchor: هذا ضعيف لأن عطايا الله في الآخرة متتابعة لا يعطي شيئا بعد شيء إلا ويظن الظان أنه ذلك أو خير منه

RAZI-FULL:v29p116#2/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v29p116#2/r4.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v29p116#2/r4.claim: A possible answer is that the lower gardens are for descendants and followers whom God joins to the first pair, and their occupants may invite whomever they wish.
RAZI-FULL:v29p116#2/r4.anchor: أن الجنتين اللتين دون الأولين لذريتهم اللذين ألحقهم الله بهم ولأتباعهم

RAZI-FULL:v29p116#2/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v29p116#2/r5.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v29p116#2/r5.claim: A second reading takes below them spatially: people inhabit two gardens and look down from above onto two more, like the chambers described in 39:20.
RAZI-FULL:v29p116#2/r5.anchor: أن المراد دونهما في المكان كأنهم في جنتين ويطلعوا من فوق على جنتين أخريين دونهما

STUDYQURAN:55:62/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:55:62/r1.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:55:62/r1.claim: The commentary directs readers to 55:48 for the difference between the Gardens of vv. 62–76 and those of vv. 48–60.
STUDYQURAN:55:62/r1.anchor: For the difference between the two Gardens described in vv. 62–76 and vv. 48–60, see 55:48c

TABATABAI:11:108#6/r4.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:11:108#6/r4.speaker: أبو عبد الله
TABATABAI:11:108#6/r4.claim: Answering Humran's objection to people leaving Hell for Paradise, Imam al-Sadiq cites 55:62: there are gardens below gardens and fires below fires, and the rescued group does not live alongside God's close servants.
TABATABAI:11:108#6/r4.anchor: قلت لأبي عبد الله عليه السلام إنهم يقولون لا تعجبون من قوم

TABATABAI:11:108#6/r5.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:11:108#6/r5.speaker: author
TABATABAI:11:108#6/r5.claim: The Imam says a station lies between these groups but cannot explain it; al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī says the Qaʾim will begin with the scoffers when he rises, as retribution.
TABATABAI:11:108#6/r5.anchor: أي إذا ظهر بدأ بهؤلاء المستهزئين بأهل الحق انتقاما

TABATABAI:55:56-74/r6.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:55:56-74/r6.speaker: author
TABATABAI:55:56-74/r6.claim: The two gardens are lower in rank, grace, and honor than the preceding pair, though similar in their blessings; they belong to believers below the sincere God-fearing, namely the people of the right.
TABATABAI:55:56-74/r6.anchor: أي أنزل درجة وأحط فضلا وشرفا منهما وإن كانتا شبيهتين بالجنتين السابقتين

TABATABAI:55:56-74/r7.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:55:56-74/r7.speaker: قيل
TABATABAI:55:56-74/r7.claim: An alternative takes the phrase to mean near the first two gardens, suggesting the later gardens also belong to their inhabitants.
TABATABAI:55:56-74/r7.anchor: وقيل معنى { من دونهما } بالقرب منهما

TABATABAI:55:56-74/r8.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:55:56-74/r8.speaker: بعضهم
TABATABAI:55:56-74/r8.claim: Some claim these two gardens are better than the preceding pair and that their descriptions are more laudatory.
TABATABAI:55:56-74/r8.anchor: بل ادعى بعضهم أن هاتين الجنتين أفضل من السابقتين والصفات المذكورة فيهما أمدح

TABATABAI:55:56-74/r9.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:55:56-74/r9.speaker: author
TABATABAI:55:56-74/r9.claim: The lower-rank reading is stronger in light of the distinction between the sincere, near-to-God and the people of the right.
TABATABAI:55:56-74/r9.anchor: وأنت بالتدبر فيما قدمناه في معنى لمن خاف مقام ربه وما يستفاد من كلامه تعالى

TABRISI:55:62/r9.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:55:62/r9.speaker: author
TABRISI:55:62/r9.claim: These are two further gardens besides the two promised to those who fear standing before their Lord; their nearness to the palace lets the blessed move joyfully between gardens and avoids boredom.
TABRISI:55:62/r9.anchor: ومن دون الجنتين اللتين ذكرناهما لمن خاف مقام ربه جنتان أخريان

TABRISI:55:62/r10.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:55:62/r10.speaker: author
TABRISI:55:62/r10.claim: Dūn here is a locative term for a place nearer to something by comparison with another thing farther away.
TABRISI:55:62/r10.anchor: ومعنى دون هنا مكان قريب من الشيء بالإضافة إلى غيره

TABRISI:55:62/r11.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:55:62/r11.speaker: قيل
TABRISI:55:62/r11.claim: Alternatively, the two gardens are lower in merit than the first pair; a prophetic report describes two gardens with silver vessels and contents and two with gold vessels and contents.
TABRISI:55:62/r11.anchor: وقيل: إن المعنى أنهما دون الجنتين الأوليين في الفضل فقد روي عن النبي

TABRISI:55:64-66/r1.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:55:64-66/r1.speaker: أبو عبد الله
TABRISI:55:64-66/r1.claim: Abu Abd Allah says believers entering Paradise may be spouses; God lets the higher-ranked spouse choose, and if the lower-ranked one is better, lets that spouse choose.
TABRISI:55:64-66/r1.anchor: عن أبي بصير عن أبي عبد الله ع قال: قلت له جعلت فداك أخبرني عن الرجل المؤمن

TABRISI:55:64-66/r2.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:55:64-66/r2.speaker: أبو عبد الله
TABRISI:55:64-66/r2.claim: Paradise has multiple gardens and ranks, with people distinguished by their deeds.
TABRISI:55:64-66/r2.anchor: قال أبو عبد الله ع: لا تقولن الجنة واحدة إن الله يقول ومن دونهما جنتان

TABRISI:55:64-66/r3.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:55:64-66/r3.speaker: أبو عبد الله
TABRISI:55:64-66/r3.claim: Those in higher stations may descend to visit lower-ranked believers; lower-ranked believers cannot ascend, but loved ones meet on couches when they wish.
TABRISI:55:64-66/r3.anchor: إن المؤمنين يدخلان الجنة فيكون أحدهما أرفع مكانا من الآخر فيشتهي أن يلقى صاحبه

TABRISI:55:64-66/r4.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:55:64-66/r4.speaker: أبو عبد الله
TABRISI:55:64-66/r4.claim: Abu Abd Allah rejects placing people released from Hell among God's close friends: they were neither unbelievers, who cannot enter Paradise, nor believers, who would not enter Hell.
TABRISI:55:64-66/r4.anchor: عن العلاء بن سيابة عن أبي عبد الله ع قال: قلت له إن الناس يتعجبون منا إذا قلنا

TABRISI:55:64-66/r5.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:55:64-66/r5.speaker: author
TABRISI:55:64-66/r5.claim: If the report is sound, those people were not among the most excellent and best of the believers.
TABRISI:55:64-66/r5.anchor: وتأويل هذا لو صح الخبر أنهم لم يكونوا من أفاضل المؤمنين وأخيارهم

THALABI:v9p192/r6.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v9p192/r6.speaker: author
THALABI:v9p192/r6.claim: The phrase means two further gardens in addition to the two first gardens.
THALABI:v9p192/r6.anchor: ومن دونهما يعني: ومن دون الجنتين الأولتين جنتان أخريان،

THALABI:v9p192/r7.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v9p192/r7.speaker: ابن عباس
THALABI:v9p192/r7.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās says these gardens are lower in rank.
THALABI:v9p192/r7.anchor: فقال ابن عباس: ومن دونهما في الدرج،

THALABI:v9p192/r8.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v9p192/r8.speaker: ابن زيد
THALABI:v9p192/r8.claim: Ibn Zayd says they are lower in merit: the first two belong to the foremost, while the two lower gardens belong to the people of the right and followers.
THALABI:v9p192/r8.anchor: وقال ابن زيد: ومن دونهما في الفضل، قال ابن زيد: هي أربع: جنتان للمقربين السابقين

THALABI:v9p192/r9.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v9p192/r9.speaker: أبو معاذ الفضل بن يحيى
THALABI:v9p192/r9.claim: Abū Muʿādh al-Faḍl ibn Yaḥyā says “other than them” is intended because these gardens are below the first pair.
THALABI:v9p192/r9.anchor: وقال أبو معاذ الفضل بن يحيى: أراد غيرهما لأنهما دون الأوليين،

THALABI:v9p192/r10.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v9p192/r10.speaker: الكسائي
THALABI:v9p192/r10.claim: Al-Kisāʾī says dunihimā means in front of them or before them, as in the cited verse's poetic usage.
THALABI:v9p192/r10.anchor: وقال الكسائي: يعني أمامهما وقبلهما، كقول الشاعر:

WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p193/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p193/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p193/r1.claim: Ibn Abbas explains the two gardens as lower in rank than the first pair.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p193/r1.anchor: قال ابن عباس: يريد أدنى من الأوليين

WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p193/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p193/r2.speaker: ابن جريج ومقاتل
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p193/r2.claim: Ibn Jurayj and Muqatil describe four gardens: the first pair for the foremost and the latter pair for the people of the right and their followers; the latter gardens are inferior, as most commentators hold.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p193/r2.anchor: قال ابن جريج: هي أربع: جنتان للمقربين السابقين كما وصفنا وجنتان لأصحاب اليمين والتابعين

WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p193/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p193/r3.speaker: أكثر المفسرين
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p193/r3.claim: Most commentators, including Ibn Zayd and al-Kalbi, hold that the second pair is lower in merit than the first pair.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p193/r3.anchor: وهو قول أكثر المفسرين أن هاتين دون الأوليين في الفضل

WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p193/r4.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p193/r4.speaker: الضحاك
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p193/r4.claim: Al-Dahhak takes the opposite view: the first two gardens are gold and silver, while the latter two are ruby and emerald and therefore superior.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p193/r4.anchor: وذهب الضحاك إلى ضد ما ذكر هؤلاء فقال: الجنتان الأوليان من ذهب وفضة

WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p193/r5.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p193/r5.speaker: الكسائي
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p193/r5.claim: On al-Kisaʾi's reading of this view, dūnahumā means in front of or before them; the author points back to the discussion at 2:23.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p193/r5.anchor: وعلى هذا قوله: {ومن دونهما} أي ومن أمامهما وقبلهما وهو قول الكسائي

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:55:62-64/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:55:62-64/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:55:62-64/r1.claim: These are two additional gardens beyond the first pair.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:55:62-64/r1.anchor: ومن دونهما } وسوى الجنتين الأوليين { جنتان } أخريان.

ELMALILI:55:56-75/r1.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:55:56-75/r1.speaker: author
ELMALILI:55:56-75/r1.claim: Elmalılı renders the phrase as two further gardens lying beyond the preceding ones.

ELMALILI:55:56-75#2/r7.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:55:56-75#2/r7.speaker: İbn Zeyd
ELMALILI:55:56-75#2/r7.claim: Ibn Zayd identifies the first pair of gardens with the foremost brought near to God, and the second pair with the companions of the right.
ELMALILI:55:56-75#2/r7.anchor: İbn Zeyd’den mervî olduğuna göre evvelkiler

ELMALILI:55:56-75#2/r8.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:55:56-75#2/r8.speaker: Hasan
ELMALILI:55:56-75#2/r8.claim: Hasan's reported view assigns the first gardens to the forerunners and the later ones to their followers.
ELMALILI:55:56-75#2/r8.anchor: Hasan’dan mervî olduğuna göre evvelkiler sâbıkīn, sonrakiler tâbi‘în içindir.

ELMALILI:55:56-75#2/r9.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:55:56-75#2/r9.speaker: author
ELMALILI:55:56-75#2/r9.claim: On those views, the second gardens are lower in rank: the first are more comprehensive and perfected in their branching qualities, expressing the highest degree of ihsan.
ELMALILI:55:56-75#2/r9.anchor: Bunlara göre ikinciler kadr ü mertebece evvelkilerden aşağı

ELMALILI:55:56-75#2/r10.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:55:56-75#2/r10.speaker: author
ELMALILI:55:56-75#2/r10.claim: Some instead hold that the later gardens have more praiseworthy qualities, making min dūnihimā mean beyond or further on from the first pair.
ELMALILI:55:56-75#2/r10.anchor: Ma‘amâfîh bazıları sonrakilerin evsâfı daha memduh olduğuna kāil olmuşlardır.

SAMARRAI-ASRAR:r7#8/r14.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-ASRAR:r7#8/r14.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-ASRAR:r7#8/r14.claim: Al-Raḥmān describes two levels of gardens, presenting the higher pair first and then explicitly labeling the other pair as lower in rank.
SAMARRAI-ASRAR:r7#8/r14.anchor: فأنت ترى أنه ذكر نوعين من الجنان بعضهما أعلى من بعض، فذكر الجنان العليا أولاً ثم قال: (ومن دونهما جنتان) أي: أقل منزلة منهما
